mapper.sql: id, device_id, reporter_id, assignee_id, title, description, severity, status, reported_at, assigned_at, resolved_at, notes, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fault_record (device_id, reporter_id, assignee_id, title, description, severity, status, reported_at, assigned_at, resolved_at, notes, created_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{reporterId}, #{assigneeId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{reportedAt}, #{assignedAt}, #{resolvedAt}, #{notes}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fault_record GROUP BY severity

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fault_record WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
